messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PGD-30021 - inference-queue-depth > 85% for pool=prod-infer (autoscaler lagging)
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered by alert rule 'inference-queue-depth-high'. Priority: P1. Escalation path started. :rotating_light:
Rohit: acked. I'm on it. investigating queue backlog and autoscaler.
Emma: +1 on ack. Rohit — do we have a recent deploy? any config changes to autoscaler?
Rohit: not that I'm aware of. No deploy in the last 2 hours. Checking autoscaler metrics: cpus at ~60%, queue length spiked ~3m ago. Looks like scale decisions aren't kicking in.
Jia: adding logs from the autoscaler controller:
```
2026-03-14T10:03:12Z controller warning: scale decision deferred - rate limit hit
2026-03-14T10:03:13Z controller info: observed queue depth 1240 targetWorkers 40 currentWorkers 28
2026-03-14T10:03:14Z controller error: failed to provision node - cloud provider quota exhausted
```
Rohit: aha — quota exhausted error. cloud provider returned 403 on node create. That would prevent autoscaler from adding nodes.
Carmen: Customer impact? any user-facing errors?
Luis: Telemetry: 502s and throttling increased on /v1/generate for some customers in eu-west-1. Error rate up from 0.3% to 4.8% in last 10m. Latency tail also increased.
Emma: ETA to mitigate? Can we force-scale existing pool (scale up replicas) instead of new nodes?
Rohit: Trying manual surge on existing Dedicated pool. Running redwoodctl (internal):
```
# attempt manual horizontal scale
redwoodctl scale pool prod-infer --replicas 50 --force
```
Rohit: redwoodctl returned: 'insufficient capacity in region eu-west-1 to attach GPU instances'
Jia: cloud quota definitely the blocker. Opening console to request quota bump is slow. Another option is to re-route critical traffic to other regions where we have capacity.
SRE Lead: Agree. Start failover routing for low-priority customers first. Keep SLA customers on current region with degraded perf. Carmen — can you compile list of accounts flagged SLA?
Carmen: compiling now. Will post list in 5m.
Rohit: Meanwhile I can temporarily scale up the fallback inference variant (cpu-quantized) in us-west-2 and route a small percentage of traffic there. Doing a controlled 10% diversion for non-SLA routes.
Emma: Please add a canary and monitor error rate/latency. Set rollback if 5xx > 1% or latency > 2x baseline.
Rohit: canary launched. Command used: `route-control shift --from eu-west-1 --to us-west-2 --percent 10 --tags "non-sla" --canary`
Luis: Logs: early signs look ok for canary. 5xx remains ~0.6% and latency +30% on canary nodes. Good so far.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Escalation reminder — if no resolution in 30m, notify escalation contact.
Rohit: Contacted cloud provider support about quota. Ticket ID CP-998211 opened. Estimated time to quota bump unknown.
Jia: Workaround idea: reduce model concurrency per worker to free up GPU memory and allow more replicas per node type. Lower token_budget config from 4096 -> 2048 for non-SLA models. That should cut memory usage ~30% and allow more pods to be scheduled on existing nodes.
Rohit: Applying concurrency tweak to non-SLA model pool now. Patch: `kubectl set env deploy/prod-model-non-sla TOKEN_BUDGET=2048`
Rohit: change applied. Observed pod density improved, scheduler placing more pods, queue length flattening.
Carmen: Posting customer impact to status page draft: "We're experiencing degraded throughput in EU region due to cloud capacity constraints. Some requests may see increased latency or 5xx errors. We're routing non-critical traffic to other regions and implementing mitigations." Any edits?
Emma: add ETA note: "expected mitigation steps in progress; monitoring and scaling actions underway; next update in 15m."
Carmen: done and published to status.redwood.ai/incidents/2104567890
SRE Lead: Handoff in 30m to next oncall (Luis). Rohit — you own until then; Luis will take post-mitigation verification and follow-up with cloud provider ticket.
Rohit: Roger. Will keep thread updated. Current timeline: 10m ago alert triggered; 6m manual canary; 4m concurrency tweak; queue depth down from 1240 -> 420. 5xx trending down.
Luis: Taking over at 11:10. I'll validate SLA customers, ensure rollback thresholds are sane, and continue follow-up with provider.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Rohit. Escalation paused.
incident-bot: Scheduled follow-up: create postmortem if incident remains P1 after 6 hours.
Rohit: Note for postmortem: autoscaler didn't surface cloud quota failure prominently — need clearer alert (quota-exhausted) and automated fallback routing faster. Also consider proactive quota monitoring.
Carmen: I've notified account managers for affected customers and sent targeted messaging for top 5 customers.
Emma: Great. Thanks team. Please add logs and screenshots to the incident doc.
Rohit: Attaching snippets and will hand off to Luis. Ending my active ops in 8m.
Luis: got it. continuing monitoring.
SRE Lead: Good work. Keep the thread updated with any cloud provider ETA or if we need to escalate to infra execs. :thumbsup:
